svg.text: MPx Squeeze v1 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
SEAL KIT · food-grade silicone, 60 ShA, FDA 21 CFR 177.2600 (team decision: silicone at every joint)
body ends to P01 web and P03 web
element base shoulder to P03 web
tap face in P10; P12 ferrule
Food contact, Cr-Ni-Mo; machine, then electropolish + passivate (ASTM A967)
Porous media grade 0.2; ISO 4003 bubble point; no binders after sintering
FDA 21 CFR 177.2600; post-cured; white/translucent, no pigment
M22×1.0 male spouts → item 10; M24×1.0 female spouts → items 11 + 10
M14×1.0-6g on the stem, 30 mm long × Ø36 free envelope ahead of the head face
FIRST-PASS PERFORMANCE (to be verified by simulation + tests)
1 CFD (OpenFOAM, porous zone): flow vs squeeze pressure, annulus distribution
2 Squeeze model: PET bottle pressure vs hand force (FEA or measured)
3 Fouling: cake-filtration model, flux decline vs litres for tap water
4 FEA: thin wall + threads at 3.4 bar and 1 m drop
5 Bench: bubble point, flow vs ΔP rig, leak test 1.5 bar
6 Challenge: 1, 2, 5, 10 µm PS beads, count before/after (Foldscope/50×)
7 Backflush recovery after 20 L of loaded water
